---
title: "Presentations"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Paste your "Publish to web" CSV link for the Presentations tab here
presentations_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTQwbP30e1rj9eR6NlSgrRrSbZybMghHNGoXHa2GylcFEaJjL3SP5j4-EdyG3Qj4MizkSyLRW9QH0dT/pub?gid=1896188767&single=true&output=csv"

presentations <- read_csv(presentations_url, show_col_types = FALSE)

safe <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)

render_presentation <- function(p) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "1.  %s %s. %s at: %s; %s; %s.\n",
    safe(p$Authors), safe(p$Title), safe(p$Format),
    safe(p$Venue), safe(p$Date), safe(p$Location)
  ))
}
```

## Invited Presentations

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

invited <- presentations |> filter(Type == "Invited Presentation")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(invited))) render_presentation(invited[i, ])
```

## Conference Presentations

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

conf_pres <- presentations |> filter(Type == "Conference Presentation")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(conf_pres))) render_presentation(conf_pres[i, ])
```

## Conference Posters

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

posters <- presentations |> filter(Type == "Conference Poster")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(posters))) render_presentation(posters[i, ])
```
